hero.headline: Your private villa in Marrakech, exclusively yours
hero.subheadline: Here, the whole estate is yours. On one hectare of olive trees, a riad with four suites, a pavilion with two suites and a separate studio sleep up to 14 guests. Private pool, hammam, vegetable garden and mini farm. A housekeeper, who is also the house cook, and a team of maids look after your stay.

home.welcome_title: A charming villa between Marrakech and the Atlas
home.welcome_body: The riad's suites open onto a quiet patio, open to the sky. In the evening, you linger there under the stars; in winter, everyone gathers in the lounge by the fire. The dining room seats up to 14.
home.suites_title: A riad, a pavilion, a studio
home.suites_sub: The estate is split into three spaces. In the riad, the Red, Blue, Green and Pink suites open onto the patio. The pavilion houses the Orange and Yellow suites, with its own lounge, kitchen, terrace and garden. The separate Studio offers 45 m² of calm.
home.experiences_title: From the hammam to the mini farm
home.experiences_sub: A traditional hammam, massage room and gym to look after yourself. In the garden: vegetable garden, mini farm and aviaries, koi pond, pétanque court, badminton and table tennis. With children, the Pickalbatros Aqua Fun Club water park, right next to the villa, is open by the day (paid entry).
home.cta_body: From €980 per night for the whole estate and up to 14 guests, breakfast and daily housekeeping included (tourist tax extra). Ideal for a family reunion, a birthday, a golf trip or a seminar. Reply within 24 hours, no commitment.
home.welcome_body2: Twenty-five minutes from the medina, on the road to the Ourika valley, the villa offers the calm of the countryside without the isolation.
home.suites_sub2: Each family keeps its own space, and everyone meets around the pool and the big table. All suites are air-conditioned, with a private shower room. The Blue Suite and the Studio have a 160 cm bed; in the other five suites, the beds can be set up as twins or joined together.

villa.page_sub: One hectare of olive trees at kilometre 17 on the Ourika road: riad and patio, pavilion, studio, private pool, vegetable garden and mini farm.
villa.intro: Our suites, set around a riad-style patio, offer a calm and enchanting setting. Admire the starry sky from the patio, enjoy the lounge with its fireplace and a dining room that seats up to 14. The ethnic, bohemian decoration, sourced and reworked by Marrakech craftsmen, creates a warm and elegant atmosphere.
villa.amenities_sub: Traditional hammam, massage room, fitness room, pétanque court, badminton and table tennis — plus the garden with its koi pond and Buddha statue.

blocks.title: The villa: a riad among the olive trees
blocks.body: The riad's four suites open onto a patio, the quiet heart of the villa. Evenings stretch on there by candlelight, under the Haouz sky.

blocks.title: The patio: a starry sky, a log fire, a table for 14
blocks.body: Around the patio, the lounge and its fireplace host winter evenings. The dining room seats up to 14 for shared meals.

blocks.title: The pavilion: a house within the house
blocks.body: Slightly apart from the riad, the pavilion brings together the Orange and Yellow suites around a lounge and a separate kitchen. Its private terrace and garden make it the ideal retreat for a family with children, or two couples who like to live at their own pace.

blocks.title: The Studio: independence
blocks.body: Set apart from the rest of the house, the Studio offers 45 m² of calm, with its sitting area and Nespresso machine. It suits those who like their own rhythm: grandparents, two friends, or a seminar organiser looking for a quiet place to work.

blocks.title: The private pool: a big pool just for you
blocks.body: In the heart of the garden, the 11 × 5 m pool is never shared with other guests. From 80 cm to 1.80 m deep, it is as good for swimming as for lounging. Sunbeds, parasols and an outdoor shower await, and lunch can be served in the shade.

blocks.title: The garden: koi carp and rediscovered silence
blocks.body: Olive trees, vegetable garden, mini farm, aviaries, koi pond, Buddha statue and pétanque court: a green refuge 25 minutes from the bustle of the medina. Vegetables from the garden end up on your table. The mini farm is home to goats, sheep, hens and ducks, watched over by the peacock.

blocks.title: Wellness: hammam, massage and gym
blocks.body: A traditional hammam, massage room, gym and a yoga and relaxation space, all under one roof. Everything you need to look after yourself between two excursions. Treatments and classes are detailed on the Services page.

villa.situation_body: Villa Serena is at kilometre 17 on the Ourika road, in Sidi Bouzguia, right next to the Pickalbatros Aqua Fun Club water park. You are about 25 minutes from Jemaa el-Fna square and Marrakech-Menara airport, and on the road to the Ourika valley and the foothills of the Atlas.

golf.page_sub: 11 championship courses within 30 minutes — bespoke golf stays.
golf.intro: Villa Serena sits at the heart of Marrakech's golfing constellation — the ideal base camp for a golf trip with friends or family, minutes from courses designed by some of the world's greatest architects.

featured.name: PalmGolf Marrakech Ourika
featured.description: The closest, on the same axis as the villa. With stunning views over the Atlas mountains, Palm Golf Ourika is a must-play course in the region, designed in a desert style by Canadian duo Neil Haworth and Stéphane Talbot.

featured.name: Akenza Golf
featured.description: Marrakech's new jewel (2025). Designed by Kyle Phillips, architect of the legendary Kingsbarns. Canyons and wadis, eight ravine crossings, an anthology-worthy 7th hole.

featured.name: Samanah Country Club
featured.description: The Jack Nicklaus signature. The first course in Africa to host a PGA Champions Tour event. Clubhouse inspired by Marrakech's ramparts.

golf.table_note: Beyond these three nearest greens, eight more courses complete the picture — eleven courses in all, designed by Nicklaus, Kyle Phillips, Robert Trent Jones, Cabell Robinson and Colin Montgomerie, all set against the Atlas mountains.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Good to know before you book

items.a: At kilometre 17 on the Ourika road, in Sidi Bouzguia, right next to the Pickalbatros Aqua Fun Club water park. Allow about 25 minutes to Jemaa el-Fna square and to Marrakech-Menara airport.

items.q: How many guests can the villa sleep?
items.a: Up to 14 guests, spread between the riad (4 suites), the pavilion (2 suites with a lounge and kitchen) and the separate Studio. The Blue Suite and the Studio have a 160 cm bed; in the other five suites, the beds can be set up as twins or joined together.

items.q: Can I book a single suite?
items.a: No. The villa is only rented as a whole: you never share the estate with other guests.

From €980 per night for the whole villa, up to 14 guests, breakfast and daily housekeeping included. The rate varies with the season: we confirm it within 24 hours for your dates. Tourist tax is not included: it is 25 dirhams per person per night, and children under 12 are exempt.
4 nights, and 6 nights in high season and over the year-end holidays.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in from 4 pm, check-out before 11 am.

items.q: How do I book and pay?
items.a: Enter your dates on the enquiry page: we confirm within 24 hours. A 50% deposit secures the booking; the balance is due 30 days before arrival.
If you cancel, we refund part of the amounts already paid: 100% up to 90 days before arrival, 70% between 89 and 60 days, 50% between 59 and 14 days, 20% within 14 days.
Yes. Its amount and form are given with your booking confirmation. It is returned after the check-out inspection.

Breakfast and daily housekeeping. Bed linen and towels (towels and bath sheets), pool towels and toiletries are provided. Fibre wifi and private parking for 7 cars. On request: meals prepared by the cook and served to the whole group at agreed times, hammam treatments, massages, excursions, transfers from Marrakech-Menara airport.

items.q: Is the villa suitable for children?
items.a: Yes: garden, mini farm, pétanque, badminton and table tennis on site, and a water park open by the day right next door. The pool has neither a fence nor an alarm: children must be supervised by an adult at all times, as our terms and conditions require. The gym is reserved for over-16s.
The 11 × 5 m private pool, 80 cm to 1.80 m deep, is not heated.

items.q: Who looks after the villa during the stay?
items.a: A housekeeper, who is also the cook, and a maid, helped by a second one depending on the size of the group, live on site, and a guard covers the night from 6 pm to 8 am. The whole team is there to give you the best service; they also take breaks and rest periods, in line with labour law. Service hours are agreed with the housekeeper on arrival. A gardener-pool keeper and a maintenance man discreetly look after the pool, the garden and the house. The grounds and outside access points are under video surveillance, and a generator takes over in case of a power cut.
Yes. The villa can be hired for private events of up to 80 guests: birthdays, family celebrations, seminars, retreats. Each event is quoted individually.

servicesPage.lead: A team lives on site and looks after your stay: a housekeeper, who is also your cook, a maid, helped by a second one depending on the size of the group, and a night guard from 6 pm to 8 am. With you throughout the day, the team also takes breaks and rest periods, in line with labour law. Breakfast and daily housekeeping are included; everything else is arranged on request.
servicesPage.serenity: Behind the scenes, a gardener-pool keeper and a maintenance man look after the pool, the garden and the house every day, discreetly. The grounds and outside access points are under video surveillance, and a generator takes over in case of a power cut, as is usual in the countryside.

restauration.title: Dining
paragraphs: Cooking at Villa Serena is entrusted to our housekeeper, who is also the house cook. She prepares every meal from Moroccan family recipes: tagines, Friday couscous, pastilla, seasonal salads. Flavours from elsewhere join in, as you wish. Vegetables come, as far as possible, from the villa's kitchen garden.

Breakfast is included every morning. Lunches and dinners are prepared on request and served to the whole group, at times agreed with the housekeeper, by the pool, under the olive trees, in the patio or in the 14-seat dining room.
Meals are designed as shared moments: the same menu, served at the same time to the whole table. The only exception: children can eat earlier or separately if they wish.

bienetre.title: Wellness
bienetre.intro: After a day of golf, a visit to the medina or an afternoon by the pool, the villa has its own wellness area, reserved for your group.
items: An ancestral purification ritual. Black-soap and kessa-glove scrub, 60 to 90 minutes.
Relaxing treatments by appointment, 45 to 90 minutes.
For a morning practice or a quiet moment. Classes and sessions with our partners, on request.
Free to use throughout your stay, reserved for over-16s under adult supervision. Weights and dumbbells, treadmill, rowing machine, weight bench, multi-station machine and punching bag.

activites.title: Activities and excursions
paragraphs: Villa Serena is on the road to the Ourika valley, gateway to the Atlas. On site, the garden has its own entertainment: pétanque court, badminton, table tennis, and the mini farm with its goats, sheep, hens, ducks and peacock, which children love. Right next door, the Pickalbatros Aqua Fun Club water park is open by the day (paid entry) for great family days out.

Further afield, we organise with partners we know: a hike to the Setti Fatma waterfalls (about 30 minutes), horse or camel rides, quad and buggy in the Agafay desert (about 35 minutes), a hot-air balloon flight at sunrise.

experiencesPage.lead: A private event, a golf trip or a yoga retreat: the whole villa is reserved for your group, with up to 14 guests staying on site.

evenements.title: Private events
paragraphs: A birthday, a family celebration, a seminar or a reception: for a day or a stay, Villa Serena is entirely yours. The olive garden, pool, patio and terraces welcome up to 80 guests, 14 of whom can stay on site.

Each event is quoted individually. Receptions are held outdoors: the villa has no covered space for a large number of guests. Music is welcome, in line with Moroccan regulations, in particular on noise, and with respect for the neighbours.
facts: The villa's kitchen or a partner caterer, on quotation

golf.title: Your golf trip in Marrakech: 14 courses around the villa
golf.paragraph: At kilometre 17 on the Ourika road, Villa Serena sits at the heart of Marrakech's golf constellation: two courses 12 minutes away, and fourteen in all within 50 minutes. On request, we arrange your transfers to the courses and your green fee bookings with our partners.
courses: Al Maaden · Royal Golf · Amelkis (27 holes) · Amelkis Resort (9 holes)

retraites.title: Yoga and wellness retreats
retraites.paragraph: For a yoga or wellness retreat, the whole villa is reserved for your group, up to 14 participants. Practice takes place in the yoga space, under the olive trees or in the patio. The hammam and massage room support recovery. The cook adapts the menus: vegetarian, gluten-free.
